name: Road to De Other Side: Drak'math resets when his target leaves his arena
contract: Issue #13537: Drak'math the Sinister King (162715) followed a player out of his arena, because dungeon creatures have no leash and the web doors have no server collision, so he could be kited away. Expected: he resets when he or his target is more than 22 yards from his spawn point (coa_boss_leash with target = 1). The arena walls stand 16 to 20 yards from the middle and the doors 19.5 yards, so a player anywhere in the arena keeps him in combat.

steps.label: p enters Road to De Other Side in the middle of Drak'math's arena
SETUP: p is in Road to De Other Side
p steps 15 yards west, still inside the arena
CONTROL: Drak'math stays in combat while p is inside the arena
p runs 16 yards further west, through the web door out of the arena
DISCRIMINATING: Drak'math resets once his target has left the arena
